_doc: The names rule sets share for what a part mounts by and what it does, so one piece of code can read any of them: a motor, a bearing, a driver, a screw. A set with "part" uses these names directly. An older set keeps its own names and says which is which in "interface". Read by cad rules check and cad rules draw.

type.says: what sort of motor, or of bearing

body_shape.says: the body's outline, seen from the mounting face

body_width.says: a square frame's side, or a box's long side

body_top.says: what stands above the mounting face, beside the shaft

body_corner.says: how far each corner of a square frame is cut back

boss_diameter.says: the pilot boss round the shaft

boss_height.says: how far the boss stands proud of the mounting face

boss_offset.says: the shaft's distance from the body's centre, where it isn't central

shaft_length.says: from the mounting face to the shaft's tip

shaft_flat_across.says: across the shaft at its flat, or across two flats

shaft_flat_length.says: the flat's length, back from the tip

horn_screw.says: the thread that holds a servo's horn

mount_pattern.says: four holes on a square, or two

mount_hole_depth.says: the thread's depth in the part

mount_ear_radius.says: the radius of an ear round its hole

mount_tab_length.says: a servo's tabs, end to end

cable_width.says: room for the wires, across the part

cable_reach.says: the wire housing's far side, from the body's centre

screw_clearance.says: a clearance hole for the screw

rated_voltage.says: the voltage its figures are given at

rated_current.says: amps per phase, or the most it works at

pull_in_torque.says: what a geared stepper starts against

friction_torque.says: friction in a built-in gearbox, at the output

torque_limit.says: the most its gearbox should see

no_load_speed.says: free running at the rated voltage

kv.says: a brushless motor's speed per volt

temperature_rise.says: the case above the room, at rated current

radial_load.says: the most sideways load on the shaft

bore.says: a bearing's bore: the shaft fits here

outer_diameter.says: a bearing's outside diameter: the housing fits here

width.says: a bearing's width along its axis; a thrust bearing's height

chamfer.says: the corner radius of a bearing's rings, the most a shaft or housing fillet may be

static_rating.says: a bearing's basic static load rating (radial, or axial for a thrust bearing)

dynamic_rating.says: a bearing's basic dynamic load rating (radial, or axial for a thrust bearing)

radial_play.says: a radial bearing's internal clearance class: CN is normal

flange_width.says: how thick a flanged bearing's flange is

shaft_washer_diameter.says: the outside of a thrust bearing's shaft washer

housing_washer_bore.says: the bore of a thrust bearing's housing washer: the shaft must clear it

actuation_force.says: the force to operate a switch

rating_mark.says: the rating marked on a switch's case

resolution.says: an encoder's resolution over a turn

air_gap_min.says: the least gap between an encoder's magnet and chip

air_gap_max.says: the most gap between an encoder's magnet and chip

magnet_field_min.says: the least field across an encoder's chip

magnet_field_max.says: the most field across an encoder's chip

magnet_thickness.says: an encoder's disc magnet, along its axis

magnet_polarity.says: how the magnet is magnetised: diametric is across the round face

supply_voltage_min.says: the least supply a board works from

supply_voltage_max.says: the most supply a board works from

pin_pitch.says: pin spacing along a header row

row_spacing.says: between a board's two header rows

pinout.says: what each pin is, in order

logic_voltage_min.says: a driver's least logic level or supply

logic_voltage_max.says: a driver's most logic level or supply

current_bare.says: a driver's continuous current per coil with no heat sink or moving air

current_cooled.says: a driver's most current per coil with cooling

current_peak.says: a driver's peak current per coil

sense_resistor.says: the resistor a driver measures coil current through

vref_formula.says: how the voltage on a driver's trimmer sets its current

vref_gain.says: the current limit per volt of Vref: A = Vref * gain (RMS for a TMC2209, the peak limit otherwise)

microsteps.says: the step divisions a driver offers

max_microsteps.says: a driver's finest division of a full step

thermal_shutdown.says: the temperature a driver's chip stops at

uart_note.says: how a driver's UART is wired
